supervision: segmentation training targets are checksum-bound clean-train pseudo masks generated from binary image labels; clean-validation polygons are used only after each epoch for model selection and after training for threshold selection
source_repair: validate pseudo masks on their immutable 320 px source grid, then record and apply the existing nearest-neighbor training transform to 448 px

training.checkpoint_primary: validation tumor-only Dice at fixed threshold 0.5
training.checkpoint_tiebreak: normal empty-mask specificity within Dice tolerance 0.0001

evaluation: all 184 clean-validation tumors including complete misses; 187 normals reported separately; group bootstrap; test remains locked
